prompts.commander_body:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: transparent 2D character puppet BODY atlas for Zero To Beyond, a children's space mission game.
Input image: existing Mira is the IDENTITY, outfit and illustration style reference for our Commander companion. Create a production animation rig atlas from her; not a poster.
Primary request: one TRANSPARENT sheet in an EXACT 3-column by 2-row equal grid, landscape 2400x1800 or a comparable 4:3 aspect ratio. Five headless body sprites plus one completely EMPTY cell. Do not draw any heads, hair, face or neck above the collar. Neck attachment at exact same center in every cell. Frame from open collar/shoulders down to just below knees (no boots needed), large detailed figure. SAME identical torso, blue flight suit, proportions, wrist watch, lighting and camera in all cells; only her free right arm pose differs. The left arm gently holds the same small charcoal tablet to her waist in all frames.
Row 1 left: listen, free arm relaxed near hip.
Row 1 center: explain, elbow bent and open palm extended welcomingly.
Row 1 right: point, free arm extended with index finger pointing gently outward.
Row 2 left: think, free hand lightly near chin position (remember NO head; hand near collar above shoulder).
Row 2 center: ready, free hand in confident small fist at chest level, not aggressive.
Row 2 right: EMPTY, fully transparent.
Composition: exact equal cells, body stays within its cell with generous transparent gutters, collars always at x=50% and y=12% of cell, belt always at y=57%, knees at y=94%; feet cut off by intentional frame below knees. No drawn grid or labels. No shadows behind figures. NO head on any body. Draw complete sleeves and natural five-finger hands; no holes, no doubled arms.
Style: premium hand-painted children's adventure illustration, fine dark ink contours, rich sapphire blue suit, polished soft shading, subtle cool rimlight, same style as reference. Transparent background, real alpha, not a checkerboard painted on it. No text, logos, NASA badges, captions, borders or scene. Output ONLY the atlas.
prompts.commander_face_a:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: TRANSPARENT registered facial animation atlas for the Commander in Zero To Beyond.
Input image 1 is our existing Mira: KEEP EXACTLY HER face, warm brown skin, dark brown swept hair in a bun, dark eyes, small gold star earrings, fine clean ink and soft painterly shading. No costume/body: HEAD ONLY including all hair, bun, ears, chin. No neck below jaw.
Primary request: one exact 4-column x 3-row sprite sheet, landscape 1600x1200 proportions. Each of the 12 equal cells contains the SAME head at the same scale, angle and coordinates, looking nearly forward with slight three-quarter turn. Keep ears, nose and eyes at fixed locations. Transparent generous gutters. Do not draw labels/grid.
ROW 1: THOUGHTFUL, gently tilted brows, a calm reflective serious expression. Col1 mouth CLOSED, eyes OPEN. Col2 same face mouth OPEN saying "ah", eyes OPEN. Col3 same face lips ROUNDED saying "oo", eyes OPEN. Col4 same face mouth CLOSED, BOTH EYES naturally CLOSED mid-blink.
ROW 2: GRATEFUL, soft warm appreciative smile, relaxed eyebrows. Col1 CLOSED mouth OPEN eyes; col2 speaking AH mouth OPEN eyes; col3 speaking OO mouth OPEN eyes; col4 CLOSED mouth CLOSED eyes mid-blink.
ROW 3: SURPRISED, raised eyebrows and wider curious eyes, child-friendly "my own mission?" surprise, not frightened. Col1 mouth CLOSED, eyes OPEN; col2 AH mouth OPEN eyes; col3 OO mouth OPEN eyes; col4 CLOSED mouth CLOSED eyes blink.
Crucial: exact same head silhouette, hairstyle, face angle, size, skin color, lighting, nose position and jaw in all cells. Expression changes ONLY brows/eyelids/lips. Never tilt/rotate head between frames. Mouth variants must not move nose/chin. Blink variants only close eyelids. Consistent small gold earrings, no text, no words, no logos, no border, no checkerboard, no background, true alpha. Whole head fits each cell with 8% transparent margins. Premium illustrated children's space adventure game, matching reference.

prompts.chief_body:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: TRANSPARENT headless body animation atlas for the Chief in Zero To Beyond, matching the attached senior Chief facial atlas's premium illustrated style.
NEW BODY: friendly fit senior South Asian mission officer, warm tan skin, dark midnight-navy flight suit with sapphire seams, subtle brass shoulder tabs and small plain gold star pin (not NASA, no text), charcoal watch. Outfit clearly senior but casual child-friendly, not military/combat. No tablet: both hands free. Sleeves cuffed at wrists.
One exact TWO-column x TWO-row equal-cell grid in a square 1600x1600 sheet. FOUR BODY sprites; ONLY body from collar down to just below knees. NO HEAD, hair, face or anything above neck stump. Complete arms with naturally drawn hands.
Row1 left GREET: right/free arm (viewer left) bent open palm raised in greeting, other arm down relaxed.
Row1 right LISTEN: both arms relaxed down, gently attentive stance.
Row2 left EXPLAIN: free arm open palm extended presenting a thought, other hand comfortably near belt.
Row2 right POINT: free index finger pointing outward gently, other hand near belt.
All cells MUST have same exact torso proportions, camera, orientation, suit, collar x50% y8%, belt y56%, knee y94%, same shoulder position; only arm gestures change. Nearly frontal slight three-quarter angle compatible with face atlas. Leave transparent margins so no hand touches cell border. Draw neck joining to collar in every frame; heads intentionally absent for rigging. Do not draw labels, gridlines, borders, words, insignia letters, background, cast shadows or checkerboard. Transparent real alpha. Fine dark ink contours, soft rich shading, subtle blue rim light, beautiful children's space adventure illustration.
